NOTE: this is the same code from draw_list_bind_render_pipeline:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/f0f6294b2d63db9e4a40a8f4bc2a77c649896df4/servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp#L5851-L5855

This change is redundant, as the original code is fine with your other fix.

Specifically, you're now setting `push_constant_size = 0` in `compute_list_bind_compute_pipeline`, when the push constant sizes don't agree.

At the top of this function, it copies the state to `compute_list_barrier_state`:

https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/f0f6294b2d63db9e4a40a8f4bc2a77c649896df4/servers/rendering/rendering_device.cpp#L7206

The original test will not bind the push constants, as it only passes when compute_list_barrier_state.push_constant_size > 0, which was now set to `0`
